ei.title: Motivation and Goal Proximity in Academic Research
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Motivation has an extensive history in academic research. Some of the earliest work on this topic was by Clark Hull, who observed that effort invested in accomplishing a goal increases as goal attainment becomes more likely. Although this conclusion was drawn by observing rats running a maze to achieve a food reward — with speed increasing as distance to the food decreased — it is nevertheless useful in seeking to explain goal pursuit in humans. Indeed, much of the modern work on motivation has built on this foundation to understand what promotes goal pursuit and achievement. For example, mirroring Hull's rats, consumers have been shown to accelerate coffee purchases as they approach the end of a '10th free' loyalty card. In the sports context, athletes are often observed to give 'one last push' as they complete a given event, and this is also often a feature both of others' efforts to motivate them despite their fatigue, and of their own self-talk. This method of motivation can also be seen when a person puts in extra effort as they reach the end of a given exercise routine. Given the centrality of motivation to success in most life domains, this topic has fascinated scholars in a range of disciplines in the social sciences, including economics and psychology.

In the sports context, athletes are often observed to give 'one last push' as they complete a given event, and this is also often a feature both of others' efforts to motivate them despite their fatigue, and of their own self-talk. This method of motivation can also be seen when a person puts in extra effort as they reach the end of a given exercise routine. Given the centrality of motivation to success in most life domains, this topic has fascinated scholars in a range of disciplines in the social sciences, including economics and psychology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 increases와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① decreases(감소하다): increases의 반의어로 가장 적절
❌ ② advances(전진하다): 유의어 방향
❌ ③ expands(확장하다): 유의어 방향
❌ ④ rises(올라가다): 유의어
det.tip: increase ↔ decrease. 증가와 감소의 기본 반의어 쌍이다.

questions.passage: Motivation has an extensive history in academic research. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 centrality와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ marginality(주변성): centrality의 반의어로 가장 적절. 중심 ↔ 주변의 대비
❌ ① importance(중요성): centrality의 유의어
❌ ② significance(중요성): centrality의 유의어
❌ ④ relevance(관련성): 중심성과 관련 있는 의미로 반의어가 아님
det.tip: centrality ↔ marginality. '중심에 있다' vs '주변부에 있다'의 대비. peripherality도 반의어로 쓸 수 있다.

questions.passage:
(A) Although this conclusion was drawn by observing rats running a maze to achieve a food reward, it proved useful in explaining human behavior as well.
(B) The artist decided to draw a portrait of the old building before it was demolished next month.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 draw의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)에서 conclusion이 '그려진다'는 것은 어색. 결론은 '도출되는' 것
✅ ② (A) 결론을 '도출하다' / (B) 초상화를 '그리다' = 각 문맥에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ (A) '끌어당기다'는 결론과 호응하지 않음
❌ ④ (B) 초상화를 '끌어당기다'는 의미가 통하지 않음
det.tip: draw는 '그리다/도출하다/끌어당기다' 등 다의어이다. draw a conclusion = 결론을 도출하다, draw a picture = 그림을 그리다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a feeling of extreme tiredness resulting from physical or mental effort"

det.analysis:
✅ ④ fatigue(피로): 신체적·정신적 노력으로 인한 극심한 피곤함이라는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ① routine(일과): 정해진 활동 순서를 의미하며 정의와 다름
❌ ② pursuit(추구): 목표를 쫓는 행위를 의미하며 정의와 다름
❌ ③ discipline(학문 분야): 지식/학문의 분야를 의미하며 피곤함과 무관
det.tip: fatigue = extreme tiredness. 본문에서 despite their fatigue(피로에도 불구하고)로 사용되었다.

questions.passage: Some of the earliest work on this topic was by Clark Hull, who observed that effort invested in __________ (accomplish) a goal increases as goal attainment becomes more likely.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 전치사 'in' 뒤에는 동명사(v-ing) 형태가 와야 한다.
det.analysis: 전치사 'in' 뒤이므로 동사 'accomplish'를 동명사 'accomplishing'으로 바꿔야 한다. 'in accomplishing a goal'은 '목표를 달성하는 데에'라는 의미이다.
det.tip: 전치사 in + 동명사(-ing). invested in accomplishing(달성하는 데 투입된)이 원문 구조이다.

questions.passage: Given the __________ (central) of motivation to success in most life domains, this topic has fascinated scholars in a range of disciplines in the social sciences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 관사 'the' 뒤에 명사 형태가 와야 한다.

det.tip: 형용사 central → 명사 centrality. the centrality of motivation to success(성공에 대한 동기의 중심성)가 원문 구조이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② goal pursuit and achievement(목표 추구와 성취): 현대 연구가 Hull의 토대 위에 '목표 추구와 성취'를 이해하기 위해 쌓아 올렸다는 핵심 구절

det.analysis:
